title: Find Nearest Point That Has the Same X or Y Coordinate
goal: Find the nearest point sharing x or y with the reference point, breaking ties by input index.
strategy: Filter for a shared coordinate, then minimize Manhattan distance. Keep the earlier candidate on equal distance.
